decisive_mechanism_evidence.fe_s_role_interpretation: Catalytic polarizing/coordination role in water elimination, not a simple electron-relay role.
decisive_mechanism_evidence.flavin_role_interpretation: FAD/FAD semiquinone participates in radical formation, H abstraction, and electron/proton bookkeeping rather than a clean hydride-transfer step.
decisive_mechanism_evidence.paraphrase: The mechanism uses oxidized FAD to initiate radical formation, then a flavin semiquinone radical anion abstracts the substrate C3-proS hydrogen. The substrate radical anion is coordinated through its hydroxy group to an Fe in the Fe-S cluster, which polarizes the hydroxy group and enables water elimination. This is radical dehydration chemistry, not ordinary flavin hydride-transfer dehydrogenase/reductase chemistry.
